capabilities: capture quick thoughts as mini notes in a configurable folder
browse notes in a Google Keep-style card grid view
filter notes with folder:, tag:, color:, type:, is: and has: operators
open a note in a separate full-screen tab via right click
extras: README asks users to star the GitHub repo and consider supporting the author; it does not document keyboard shortcuts beyond suggested hotkeys (Ctrl+[ and Ctrl+]).
problem: Obsidian lacks a lightweight, visual space for jotting quick thoughts without organizing them into folders or links first.

relations.evidence: view your notes in a google keep-notes similar layout

summary: Sticky-note style plugin that stores quick thoughts as regular notes and displays them in a Google Keep-like card grid with colors, pins and filters.
